verdict.reasons: The primary product (AFP drip tape) is correctly identified, fully visible, and matches the expected count without any mixed or replaced product families. The branding, watermark, and product geometry are authentic and integrated naturally into the scene. However, the image fails to meet the minimum quality threshold because the specific technical evidence described in the metadata is missing. The data requires a 'closed ribbed compression union installed inline between two continuous black irrigation pipes' with visible joined ends. The candidate image instead shows a standard continuous pipe line ending in an open end near the tape carton, completely lacking the required specialized fitting hardware. This absence of the specific technical illustration is a core condition mismatch.
